title: 第13章 先天侦察测绘圣体
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “底稿，我已经画好了，你直接往上誊就行.......”“不是，我就转个头的工夫，你打型都打的差不多了？”路边花坛，宣传栏前。指导员何镇涛和陆阳一人一边，各画各的。出过黑板报的都知道，在大黑板上作画前，需要找等位点，也就是所谓的等比放大。可何镇涛还在用尺子测量比例，陆阳那边的大致框架居然就已经勾勒出来。连尺子都没用，全然一副我的眼睛就是尺的架势。这让他这个出板报多年的老政工，多少有种被后浪拍在沙滩上的感觉。“陆阳，你跟导员说实话，你真就只学了几个月素描，我怎么看你像是学了好几年的！”“真就学了几个月。”陆阳手里攥着粉笔，站在板凳上回过头。他真就只学过几个月素描，但因为兴趣使然。以前上课不认真听讲，总喜欢在课本插图上写写画画。时间久了，绘画塑形功底就练出来了，再加上喜欢看漫画，没事儿就照着临摹。久而久之，班里的黑板报都被他给承包了；画的多了，自然也就熟练了。何镇涛见他信手拈来的线条，比自已用尺子找形找的还要准，也是不由得感叹真是找对人了。“你觉得，我这稿子有没有什么需要改进的地方，从你专业的眼光给提提意见？”“指导员，我觉得这就挺好的，没啥要改的地方。”“不行，必须提个意见出来，这是命令！”部队的宣传栏从来就不是摆设，是要传递正能量，和积极思想的。不仅要给战士们看，上级领导下来检查的时候也会注意到，可马虎不得。何镇涛作为主抓思想教育工作的政工干部，在宣传部队精神方面，眼里揉不得一丁点沙子。尤其是新训初始阶段，思想建设工作更是重中之重，所以他对于板报内容格外看重。陆阳也是没辙了，随口提了个想法：“角落这把竖着的钢枪，好像有点儿孤零零的，要不加个旗帜缠绕效果？”说着，他就用红色粉笔，在钢枪上勾勒出几个向上飘逸的线条。代表红色旗帜温柔的拂过钢枪，随风飘扬远处，和右侧的山河大地形成呼应。何镇涛立马用红笔在底稿上同样勾勒了几下，就是这寥寥几笔，让他顿感眼前一亮。不仅左右两边画面多了联动性，也让板报内容更加鲜活，精神内核也丰富了许多。“你小子，可以啊，有点儿东西！”“我这纯粹就是化蛇......”“是画龙点睛！来来来，你帮我打型，一会儿细节我自已来。”二人相互配合，很快就将板报修改后的大致雏形给弄了出来。为了不耽误陆阳训练，何镇涛让他先忙活，回头中午吃完饭再接着搞。“指导员，那我先去训练了？”“去吧去吧。”看着陆阳放下彩笔，飞快的跑向训练场。何镇涛面带笑意，对他的印象更好了。喜欢读书，励志考学，还会画画出板报，简直先天文职圣体。他站远一些，看着宣传栏上的板报，越看越对陆阳的巧思感到满意。“当你的秀发，拂过我的钢枪......铁汉柔情，也象征着投入祖国母亲的怀抱！”作为一名老政工，他看待事物，习惯性的会对其赋予各种特殊的教育意义和精神内涵。但当时，陆阳只是觉得孤零零的一把枪杵在那，显得画面有点儿空，压根就没想到这么多。正巧，连长高峰视察完新兵们的训练工作，从远处走来。“动作这么快，大型已经出来了？”“嘿嘿，找了个帮手。”“哟，咱们连，还有个绘画小能手？”“那小子没系统性学过，纯粹就是天赋好。你瞧，人家随手画的，比我用尺子找的型还要准。”“几班的？”“三班的，就点验那天带不少书来的那个，叫陆阳。”“啧啧啧，是个侦察测绘的好手啊！”听到高峰的调侃，何镇涛白了一眼。“细胳膊细腿的，搞什么侦察测绘，要我说是个干文职，搞文化宣传的好手。”“哈哈哈哈，你说是就是吧。”高峰倒也没和他争辩什么，但却将陆阳这个兵给记下了。虽说身体素质差了点，但在绘画上头有天赋的兵，值得多关注关注。因为侦察兵在对敌进行渗透侦察时，主要工作就是对地形地貌，以及敌方重要设施分布进行测绘标记，方便后方重火力单位群进行有效打击。而这，就涉及到等比放量，还有一定描绘技巧。正巧，这个新兵有这方面的天赋，那就省事儿多了。......“报告！”“归队吧！”陆阳喊了声报告，重新回到三班队伍里。孔垄见他回来了，一阵挤眉弄眼：“板报出完啦？”陆阳：“没呢，中午还得接着忙。”孔垄羡慕：“你这算不算，跟导员攀上关系了？”陆阳没好气的说：“我这是义务劳动，纯纯干苦力。”话虽如此，但其他新兵多少还是带着点儿羡慕。新兵连，除了连长，就属指导员权力最大。先前宣传栏那边，二人有说有笑一块儿忙碌的身影他们也瞧见了。如果把班长比作班主任，那指导员就是学校里的教导主任，刚入学就能和教导主任说说笑笑，这还不牛逼？而这一幕也让一直作为学校“风云人物”的丁腾飞逐渐破防，心中对于这个老乡抢风头的行为愈发不爽。自打入伍，他就从人人敬畏的丁哥，成了个天天挨骂的小喽啰，这种参差感让他莫名有种，想把陆阳比下去的冲动！“安静！”周凯东罕见的没发火。换作以往，队伍里有人议论。他要么喊“闭嘴”，要么帽子直接砸过去，再要么就是让人上来讲。这次，纯属是看在陆阳面子上；因为周凯东也能瞧出来，指导员很喜欢陆阳。部队里，出板报是件大事，逢年过节或是有领导下来检查了，板报内容都得更新。而具备这项特长的，往往都会比较容易得到文职干部的赏识和青睐。这就好比有厨师证会做饭的兵，格外招炊事班稀罕是一个意思。哔哔哔的哨声响起，一二班很快朝着这边汇集，组成一个排。兼任一排长职务的周凯东，站在队伍前面大声说：“待会跑个三公里，和以往不同，这次不光会记时，还会作为你们平时成绩！”“这是你们入伍以来第一次检验，都给我上点心，尤其是那些平时就喜欢拖拖拉拉的！”“所有人，半面向右转，上跑道！”新兵们呼啦啦的全部来到跑道上，各班长分别拿出成绩册和秒表，准备对新兵成绩进行记录。对于参军后的第一次小测验，新兵们格外重视，一个个摩拳擦掌的都想拿个好成绩。陆阳也在活动关节，拉伸肌肉韧带，他迫不及待的想看看以自已目前体能状态，全力跑完一个三公里究竟需要多久？就在准备阶段，他忽然瞧见丁腾飞一脸挑衅的盯着自已，似是要与自已争个高低？陆阳也是丝毫不虚，一个眼神就瞪了回去。连带着一起瞪回去的，还有孔垄恶狠狠的目光。“你愁啥？”“瞅你咋的！”“不服，比比？”“比就比！”一排所有新兵各就各位，随着哨声响起，一道身影飞快的冲了出去。看着丁腾飞一骑绝尘的背影，周凯东的眉头当即就皱了起来。一班长和二班长也都露出一副，等着看好戏的冷笑。果不其然，在跑出去一两百米后，这小子就捂着侧边肋骨，面露痛苦之色。“草，岔气了！”“山炮！”没一会儿，孔垄就从后头反超上来，并冲他比了个中指。陆阳则是选择性的无视，以三步一呼两步一吸的方式，稳扎稳打匀速前进......
content_en: "I've already drawn the draft, you can just copy it..." "No, I just turned around and you were almost done with the shape?" In front of the roadside flower bed, in front of the publicity board.Instructors He Zhentao and Lu Yang were on one side, each drawing his own painting.Anyone who has published a blackboard newspaper knows that before painting on a large blackboard, you need to find equal points, which is the so-called equal-ratio enlargement.But He Zhentao was still using a ruler to measure the proportions, and Lu Yang's rough outline had already been sketched out.He didn't even use a ruler, he just acted like my eyes are rulers.This makes him, a veteran political worker who has published newspapers for many years, feel like he has been slapped on the beach by the waves behind him."Lu Yang, tell the instructor the truth. You've really only studied sketching for a few months. It seems to me that you have been studying for several years!" "It's really been a few months." Lu Yang held the chalk in his hand and stood on the bench and turned around.He really only learned sketching for a few months, but it was because of his interest.I used to not listen carefully in class and always liked to write and draw on the illustrations in the textbook.Over time, I have developed my painting and sculpting skills. In addition, I like reading comics, so I just copy them when I have nothing to do.Over time, he was responsible for all the blackboard newspapers in the class; the more he drew, the more proficient he became.When He Zhentao saw that the lines he picked up at random were more accurate than his own shapes with a ruler, he couldn't help but sigh that he had found the right person."Do you think there is anything that needs to be improved in my manuscript? Can you give me some advice from your professional perspective?" "Instructor, I think this is pretty good. There is nothing to change." "No, I have to give my opinion. This is an order!" The army's propaganda board has never been a decoration. It is to convey positive energy and positive thoughts.Not only must it be shown to the soldiers, but the superiors will also notice it when they come to inspect, but nothing can be done carelessly.As a political cadre who focuses on ideological education work, He Zhentao has no regard for the slightest bit of sand in his eyes when it comes to publicizing the spirit of the army.Especially in the initial stage of new training, ideological construction is the top priority, so he pays special attention to the content of blackboard newspapers.Lu Yang was at his wits end and casually raised an idea: "The vertical steel gun in the corner seems a bit lonely. How about adding a flag wrapping effect?" As he said that, he used red chalk to outline several upward flowing lines on the steel gun.The representative red flag gently brushes the steel gun and flutters in the distance in the wind, echoing the mountains, rivers and land on the right.He Zhentao immediately used a red pen to outline the manuscript a few times. It was these few strokes that made his eyes light up.Not only are the left and right pictures more interconnected, it also makes the content of the blackboard more vivid and enriches the spiritual core."You kid, yes, there's something!" "I'm just turning into a snake..." "It's the finishing touch! Come on, come on, you help me shape it, and I'll come up with the details later." The two of them cooperated with each other and soon came up with the rough prototype of the revised blackboard newspaper.In order not to delay Lu Yang's training, He Zhentao asked him to work first and continue after lunch."Instructor, should I go to training first?" "Let's go, let's go." He saw Lu Yang put down his colored pen and ran to the training ground quickly.He Zhentao smiled and had a better impression of him.He likes reading, is motivated to take exams, and can draw pictures for blackboard newspapers. He is simply a gifted clergyman.He stood farther away and looked at the newspaper on the bulletin board. The more he read, the more satisfied he was with Lu Yang's ingenuity."When your hair brushes my steel gun...the tenderness of a man also symbolizes falling into the arms of the motherland!" As an old political worker, he habitually gives various special educational meanings and spiritual connotations to things when he looks at them.But at that time, Lu Yang just felt that there was a solitary gun standing there, making the scene a bit empty, and he didn't expect so much at all.By chance, company commander Gao Feng came from a distance after inspecting the training of the new recruits."You're moving so fast. The big one has already come out?" "Hey, we found a helper." "Hey, our company also has a little expert in painting?" "That kid hasn't studied systematically, he just has a good talent. You see, what he draws casually is better thanThe shape I found with the ruler was even more accurate." "What class are you from?" "The one who brought a lot of books that day is named Lu Yang." "Tsk, tsk, he's a good at reconnaissance and mapping!" He Zhentao rolled his eyes when he heard Gao Feng's teasing."A guy with thin arms and thin legs, who is engaged in reconnaissance and surveying. If you ask me, he is a good person in civilian work and cultural propaganda." "Hahahaha, that's right." Gao Feng didn't argue with him, but he remembered Lu Yang as a soldier.Although his physical fitness is a bit poor, he is talented in painting and deserves more attention.Because when the scouts conduct infiltration reconnaissance against the enemy, their main job is to map and mark the terrain and the distribution of important enemy facilities, so as to facilitate the effective attack of heavy firepower units in the rear.And this involves proportional volume and certain depiction skills.It just so happens that this recruit has talent in this area, so it will be much easier...."Report!" "Return to the team!" Lu Yang shouted the report and returned to the third team.When Kong Long saw him coming back, he winked and said, "Is the newspaper finished?" Lu Yang said, "No, I have to continue working at noon." Kong Long was envious: "Does this count as a relationship with the instructor?" Lu Yang said angrily: "I am voluntary labor, just hard work." Even so, the other recruits were still a little envious.In a recruit company, apart from the company commander, the instructor has the most power.They also saw the two of them chatting and laughing and busy together at the bulletin board.If the squad leader is compared to the class teacher, then the instructor is the dean of the school. Isn’t this awesome when you can chat and laugh with the dean when you first enter school?This scene also made Ding Tengfei, who had always been the "person of the hour" in the school, gradually break his defenses, and became increasingly unhappy with this fellow's behavior of stealing the limelight.Since he joined the army, he has gone from being the respected Ding brother to a little guy who is scolded every day. This feeling of disparity makes him have an inexplicable urge to compare with Lu Yang!"Quiet!" Zhou Kaidong rarely got angry.In the past, there would have been some discussion in the team.He would either shout "shut up", or throw his hat at him, or he would have someone come up and talk.This time, it was purely for Lu Yang's face; because Zhou Kaidong could also tell that the instructor liked Lu Yang very much.In the army, publishing blackboards is a big deal. During holidays or when leaders come to inspect, the contents of the blackboards must be updated.Those with this specialty are often more likely to be appreciated and favored by civilian cadres.This is like a soldier who has a chef certificate and can cook. It means that it is rare to be recruited into the cooking class.The whistle beeped, and the first and second squads quickly gathered here to form a platoon.Zhou Kaidong, who also serves as the first platoon leader, stood in front of the team and said loudly: "We will run three kilometers later. Different from the past, this time not only will the time be recorded, but it will also be used as your daily results!" "This is the first test since you joined the army. Give me snacks, especially those who usually like to procrastinate!" "Everyone, half turn to the right and get on the track!" The recruits all came to the track with cheers. Each squad leader took out the score book and stopwatch, preparing to record the recruits' results.The recruits pay special attention to the first quiz after joining the army, and they are all gearing up to get good results.Lu Yang was also moving his joints and stretching his muscles and ligaments. He couldn't wait to see how long it would take him to complete a three-kilometer run with his current physical condition.During the preparation stage, he suddenly saw Ding Tengfei staring at him provocatively, as if he wanted to compete with him?Lu Yang was not false at all and stared back with one look.Kong Long's vicious gaze was also stared back at him."What are you worried about?" "What are you looking at!" "Don't accept it, Bibi?" "Bibi!" All the recruits in the row took their positions. As the whistle sounded, a figure rushed out quickly.Looking at Ding Tengfei's back, Zhou Kaidong immediately frowned.The first squad leader and the second squad leader also sneered as if they were waiting for a good show.Sure enough, after running a hundred or two hundred meters, the kid was clutching his side ribs with a look of pain on his face."Hey, I'm out of breath!" "Mountain gun!" After a while, Kong Long came up from behind and gave him a middle finger.Lu Yang selectively ignored it and moved forward steadily and at a steady pace with three steps, one exhale, two steps and one inhale...
